summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust filed an 8-K covering two routine operational events. Under Item 3.02, the company sold 3,203,718 common shares (Classes S, D, I, and E) for gross proceeds of approximately $33.2 million at May 31, 2026 NAV per share; the sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and Regulation S. Under Item 8.01, it declared monthly distributions of $0.0416667 per share across all classes, paid on June 16, 2026. The filing also disclosed NAV per share as of May 31, 2026 (ranging from $10.3168 to $10.4640). There are no special-situation elements; it is a standard periodic disclosure of equity sales and distribution declarations.
